Now apply Bernoulli with loss between sections.

The general principle: For flow from section i to i+1, the Bernoulli equation modified by loss: p_i + (1/2)ρ v_i^2 + ρ g z_i = p_{i+1} + (1/2)ρ v_{i+1}^2 + ρ g z_{i+1} + Δp_loss_i, where Δp_loss_i = K_i * (1/2) ρ v_i^2. Note that loss coefficient uses upstream velocity.

Thus p_{i+1} = p_i + (1/2)ρ (v_i^2 - v_{i+1}^2) + ρ g (z_i - z_{i+1}) - Δp_loss_i.

But careful: Δp_loss_i = K_i * (1/2) ρ v_i^2. So subtract that.

Let’s denote:

p1 = 265000.

Define dp_i = 500 * v_i^2.

Define delta_z_i = z_i - z_{i+1} for i=1..5.

Then p_{i+1} = p_i + dp_i - dp_{i+1} + ρg * delta_z_i - K_i * dp_i = p_i + (1 - K_i) dp_i - dp_{i+1} + ρg delta_z_i.

So we can compute sequentially:

p2 = p1 + (1 - K12) dp1 - dp2 + ρg (z1 - z2)
p3 = p2 + (1 - K23) dp2 - dp3 + ρg (z2 - z3)
...
p6 = p5 + (1 - K56) dp5 - dp6 + ρg (z5 - z6)

Now substitute numbers:

K12 = 1.4, so 1-K12 = -0.4.
K23 = 1.2, 1-K23 = -0.2.
K34 = 1.1, 1-K34 = -0.1.
K45 = 0.3, 1-K45 = 0.7.
K56 = 0.2, 1-K56 = 0.8.

We'll compute p6 using symbolic summation to avoid repeated rounding.

We have p6 = p1 + sum over i=1 to 5 of [ (1-K_i) dp_i - dp_{i+1} + ρg (z_i - z_{i+1}) ]? Actually it's telescoping: p6 = p1 + Σ_{i=1}^{5} ( (1-K_i) dp_i - dp_{i+1} + ρg Δz_i ). This equals p1 + Σ (1-K_i) dp_i - Σ dp_{i+1} + ρg Σ Δz_i. But Σ dp_{i+1} = dp2+dp3+dp4+dp5+dp6. Σ Δz_i = z1 - z6. So p6 = p1 + (1-K12)dp1 + (1-K23)dp2 + (1-K34)dp3 + (1-K45)dp4 + (1-K56)dp5 - (dp2+dp3+dp4+dp5+dp6) + ρg (z1 - z6).

Simplify: p6 = p1 + (-0.4)dp1 + (-0.2)dp2 + (-0.1)dp3 + 0.7dp4 + 0.8dp5 - dp2 - dp3 - dp4 - dp5 - dp6 + ρg (z1 - z6).

So p6 = p1 -0.4 dp1 -1.2 dp2 -1.1 dp3 -0.3 dp4 -0.2 dp5 - dp6 + ρg (z1 - z6).
